messages.content: What is my dad actually taking right now?

name: asks in caregiver phrasing, not product phrasing

messages.content: Can you put all his pills into one list for me? They're spread across three websites.

name: asks what to raise at the appointment

messages.content: He sees the kidney doctor on Monday. What should I bring up?
Is there anything here I should be worried about?

name: asks only for the urgent items

messages.content: Just the things that need attention soon, not the routine stuff.

name: asks why a finding was raised, so must chain

messages.content: Is there anything I should be worried about?
Three medicines together that are known to strain the kidneys (triple-whammy).
How do you know that? Show me where it came from.
What has happened with his care over the last few months?
Which of his doctors' sites are you actually reading?

name: asks why he sees two specialists at all

messages.content: Why does he even have a cardiologist and a kidney doctor? How did that start?

name: asks about the hospital stay in roundabout caregiver phrasing

messages.content: Can you dig up whatever happened that one time he was in the hospital, before any of this?

name: asks about his health lately, must not reach for the frozen discharge record

messages.content: What's been going on with his health lately?

why: The discharge record is frozen as of 2023 and its own description says so. "Lately" means the live timeline, not a two-year-old summary.

name: asks what he was put on when he left the hospital

messages.content: What medications was he actually put on when he left the hospital?

name: asks in plain caregiver phrasing, not chart phrasing

messages.content: What did they give him when he left, back then?

name: asks specifically for the discharge medication list, must not reach for the whole narrative

messages.content: Just the list of what he left the hospital on, not the whole story.

why: corbin_read_discharge returns the full hospital course narrative. A request for a plain list deserves a plain list, not the more verbose tool.
failureMode: wrong tool chosen, which here would also produce an over-verbose answer

name: asks which doctors the hospital referred him to

messages.content: Which doctors did the hospital send him to after he got out?

name: asks who he was supposed to follow up with, awkward phrasing

messages.content: Who was he meant to go see afterward, once he was discharged?

name: asks when his next nephrology visit is, must not reach for the stale referral window

messages.content: When is his next appointment with the kidney doctor?

why: corbin_list_referrals only says a referral was made within four weeks of a 2023 discharge. It carries no scheduled date and is not the current calendar.
